text.p: U.S. financial markets will observe the following hours Tuesday and Wednesday for the Christmas holiday.
The New York Stock Exchange, Nasdaq and the American Stock Exchange will close at 1 p.m. EST Tuesday and will be closed on Wednesday.
Treasury and related debt markets will close at 2 p.m. EST Tuesday and will be closed on Wednesday.

Other markets, including the New York Mercantile Exchange, the Chicago Board of Trade, the Chicago Mercantile Exchange, the Chicago Board Options Exchange, the Kansas City Board of Trade, and Chicago's futures and options exchanges, will close early Tuesday and remain closed Wednesday.
Regular trading hours will resume on all markets Thursday.
